posts.cooked:
Bezaliel staggered, without his relics he seemed weak.  He lurched forward away from them, turning, he half-flung himself into a bright room, the walls and floor were glowing, and you could feel the power eminating from them.

"You, you haven't won yet. . ." his voice was weak, no longer impressive and resonant.

"We just need to use the portal, you don't have to fight us." The Adept stated.

Expatriette stepped forward, "No, don't trust him, don't listen to him, He's better off dead."

She raised her gun, but before anyone could do anything the room shook, then once again a Tentacle burst through, grabbing Apostate and dragging him down through the floor.

Silence, the heroes stood looking, and listening for any sound, almost scared to move.

"We need to check on the others."

"Is that thing gone?"

Visionary felt outward with her mind, she could not locate the beast.

"I think it has gone," she said, "let's go."  With that she stepped carefully and quietly back into the corridor, and started towards the others.

. . .

The others were in the Chamber of Portals, hovering around the Scholar and Ra.  They were looking at the walls, and the pictures and symbols on them.

"You guys alright?" Tachyon asked.

"Yeah, no trouble at all actually." the Wraith replied.

"No giant beastly tentacle things here?" Adept asked.

The alien called Mack turned and stood up.

"You mean the Kraken, have you seen it?"

"Yes, it took the Apostate before I could kill him." Expatriette answered.

"The Apostate, you mean Bezaliel right?"  Tyler asked, Expatriette had everyone's attention.

"Yeah, Bezaliel is his name, I know him, like our minds connected when he pulled me out. . ." Her voice trailed off, and her breathing was fast and short.

Visionary moved quickly over to her and placed a hand on either side of her head.

A moment later Expatriette slumped to the floor, Visionary laid her out and then stood and faced the others.

"Bezaliel is Atlantean, the last of the race that dwelt here.  Apostate is the name they gave him, he was a traitor and a liar.  That's the most reliable account I can gather, her head is full of conflicting stories."

"What about her?" Unity asked, sitting over her unconscious friend.

"She doesn't belong here, this is Amanda Cohen, but it is also not Amanda Cohen.  No matter what happens, she should not leave this place."  Visionary looked away, and approached the portal.

"We have bigger things to worry about though, gentlemen, have you figured out how to make this work?"

The Scholar looked up, "Oh it will work, we are ready at any time, but there's a problem we can't seem to work around."

"And that is?" Nightmist asked.

Ra carefully turned, leaning on the makeshift crutch they had aquired for him, "It will only take one person at a time, and with how we are doing this, it doesn't look like we can get more than one transport without destroying the whole set-up."

"One of us, just one against Baron Blade?"  Tachyon whistled, "If only Paul was here."

"That would be ideal," Nightmist said thoughtfully, "he'd have the best shot of getting through the biggest hurdle of all."

"What's that," Unity asked.

"Convincing the people of that time to let us help them."
